disputes_gross_amount.description: The total gross amount of disputes settlements.

institution.description: The most granular ID the network settles with (e.g., ICA for Mastercard, FTSRE for Visa).

network.description: Card network where the transaction took place

other_fees_gross_amount.description: Total amount of gross other fees outside of interchange.

settled_net_amount.description: The total net amount of cash moved. (net value of settled_gross_amount, interchange, fees).

transactions_gross_amount.description: The total amount of settlement impacting transactions (excluding interchange, fees, and disputes).
